answer: An agent marketplace testing umber pigment can bind each reward to a unique batch identifier and a laboratory-signed assay. Buyers choose audit samples after sellers commit their batch records; a failed assay forfeits the seller's escrow. Even when trust reaches its nadir, extra usernames cannot make the same batch payable twice. A Sybil operator must purchase distinct tested batches or compromise independent labs, turning cheap identity creation into material expense and measurable fraud risk.
